shortDescription: Petrobras NYSE:PBR and Vale NYSE:VALE jumped 8.4% and 6.7%, respectively, pre-market Monday after Flávio Bolsonaro took a surprise lead over incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of Brazil's presidential election, making him the clear favorite to win the runoff and take the country…

children: jumped 8.4% and 6.7%, respectively, pre-market Monday after Flávio Bolsonaro
over incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of Brazil's presidential election, making him the clear favorite to win the runoff and take the country's economy to the right.

The runoff will occur October 25, but closing the gap likely will prove difficult for Lula in what is likely his last race, given that most support for eliminated candidates is expected to fall in behind Bolsonaro.
Investors have largely backed Bolsonaro, the eldest son of imprisoned former President Jair Bolsonaro, seeing him as more likely to pursue policies to address Brazil's deteriorating fiscal situation.

Whoever ends up winning will inherit pressure to address Brazil’s public finances, with high government debt, a large budget deficit, and elevated borrowing costs placing fiscal policy at the center of investors' attention.

title: Petrobras, Vale surge as Bolsonaro edges Lula ahead of Brazil election runoff
